candidate_law: all nonzero integer (a,b) in [-B,B]^2, ascending frozen Decimal quadratic height score, then a,b
point_law: construct exact rational P=aQ+bR with accepted Sage; check finite reduction equals a*Qbar+b*Rbar; include every evaluated point, zero reduction and duplicate
stop_rule: first prefix covering all q-1 nonidentity reduced points, full coefficient box, or per-cell 300-second wall cap; retain censored status and counts
cache_policy: each cell starts a fresh rational-point evaluation sequence; no cross-cell cache; curve and pairing setup outside per-cell evaluation interval
measurements: candidate evaluations, first finite collision or zero-reduction relation, nonidentity coverage at stop, exact rational coordinate bit peak, per-cell construction-and-reduction wall time, process max RSS, status
claim_boundary: ordinary-host construction-cost diagnostic on two prior selected cells; timings are exploratory and do not establish a calibrated IC/rho comparison
